title: Palindrome Degree
statementMd:
String $*s*$ of length $*n*$ is called $*k*$-palindrome, if it is a palindrome itself, and its prefix and suffix of length ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/baaa1cf00a178570d9b63b0518b73899b9a96307.png) are $(*k* - 1)$-palindromes. By definition, any string (even empty) is 0-palindrome.

Let's call the palindrome degree of string $*s*$ such a maximum number $*k*$, for which $*s*$ is $*k*$-palindrome. For example, "`abaaba`" has degree equals to $3$.

You are given a string. Your task is to find the sum of the palindrome degrees of all its prefixes.

## Input

The first line of the input data contains a non-empty string, consisting of Latin letters and digits. The length of the string does not exceed $5·10^{6}$. The string is case-sensitive.

## Output

Output the only number — the sum of the polindrome degrees of all the string's prefixes.
statementZhMd:
长度为 $*n*$ 的字符串 $*s*$ 被称为 $*k*$-回文，当且仅当它本身是回文串，并且其长度为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/baaa1cf00a178570d9b63b0518b73899b9a96307.png) 的前缀和后缀都是 $(*k* - 1)$-回文。根据定义，任意字符串（甚至空字符串）都是 0-回文。

我们将字符串 $*s*$ 的回文度定义为满足 $*s*$ 是 $*k*$-回文的最大数值 $*k*$。例如，"`abaaba`" 的回文度为 $3$。

给定一个字符串。你的任务是求出它的所有前缀的回文度之和。

## 输入格式

输入数据的第一行包含一个非空字符串，仅由拉丁字母和数字组成。字符串的长度不超过 $5·10^{6}$。该字符串区分大小写。

## 输出格式

输出唯一一个数——给定字符串所有前缀的回文度之和。
